subject: Approval request: $25,000 PLG credit for Finova expansion
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request: $25,000 PLG credit for Finova expansion

Team —

Quick background: Finova (prospect) signed up via PLG last month and their engineering and payments teams have been heavy users. They started with the free tier and have already consumed ~400k tokens/day in evaluation flows. The AE (Samir) estimates $300k ACV if they commit to a pilot + embed our embeddings for production.

Request: Samir has asked for a one-time promotional credit of $25,000 to accelerate a 90-day pilot and cover initial API usage while they complete procurement. This is above our standard promo cap and requires leadership sign-off.

Why it makes sense:
- Strong expansion signal: multiple teams (payments, fraud, analytics) are engaged
- Short runway risk: without credit they will throttle evaluation and likely pause
- Competitive urgency: they’re considering a vendor that offers bigger short-term credits

Proposed guardrails if approved:
- Credit valid for 90 days from issuance
- Usage reporting enabled; monthly check-ins with AE and CS
- Auto-throttle if daily spend spikes beyond agreed thresholds

Attachments: proposed_credit_note.pdf (proposed terms) and a short account brief.

Ask: Rishi/Vivek/Markus — please approve or request changes. If approved, Sales Ops (Neha) will coordinate issuance through the self-serve credits workflow and we’ll notify the customer.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

Laura — thanks for the summary. A couple quick asks before I sign off:
1) Can you add the HubSpot deal id and the committed next-step (pilot start date / POC owner)?
2) Any known compliance asks (SOC2, data residency) from the prospect that would affect Private options?

If those look clean I’m provisionally +1, would like Vivek or Markus to confirm for final.

-Rishi

Thanks Rishi — answers inline:
- HubSpot deal: FIN-2026-0317 (link included below).
- Pilot start: target week of 2026-03-15; POC owner: Nadia (Finova engineering).
- Compliance: they asked about SOC 2 and encryption-at-rest; they’re fine with hosted for pilot but procurement will request SOC2 evidence during contract. They are not asking for on-prem/VPC for the pilot.

Attaching Finova_account_brief.pdf which includes evaluation metrics and the AE’s commercial note.

If Vivek/Markus are comfortable, we’ll lock the 90-day credit and Neha will handle issuance.

Laura

Thanks Laura — looked through the brief. I’m supportive of the credit with two conditions:
1) Credit expires after 90 days and is non-transferable.
2) We require a short kickoff call (CS + AE + Finova POC) within two weeks of issuance; usage metrics to be shared weekly for the first month.

Neha — please add a ledger entry for the $25k promotional credit and record the expiration date. Also capture the HubSpot deal id FIN-2026-0317 in the finance note.

Rishi/Markus — if you’re both OK, this would be my official approval.

Vivek
Head of Revenue, Redwood Inference
